metadata.name: DMV Employer Cost Index
metadata.purpose: DMV-specific statutory figures for /dmv-employer-cost-index that are not in rates-2026.json. Federal FICA/FUTA and state unemployment-insurance rates are read from rates-2026.json so the index and the Cost Lab never disagree.

socialSecurityWageBase2027.sourceName: Journal of Accountancy, Social Security wage base and COLA announced for 2027 (SSA announcement Oct 14, 2026)

DC.name: DC Paid Family Leave
DC.note: Employer-funded. The FY2027 law kept the rate at 0.75% while cutting benefits for claims filed on or after Oct 1, 2026: family leave 12 to 6 weeks, medical leave 12 to 10 weeks, maximum weekly benefit $1,190 to $1,100.

sources.name: Epstein Becker Green, DC rolls back paid-leave benefits (Sep 23, 2026)
OnPay, DC Paid Family Leave (updated May 20, 2026)
GovDocs, DC paid family leave changes take effect Oct 1, 2026

MD.name: Maryland FAMLI
MD.note: Total 0.90% of wages up to the Social Security wage base. Employers with 15 or more employees pay at least half and may withhold up to half (0.45%) from pay. Employers with fewer than 15 owe no employer share but must remit any employee share they withhold. Benefits begin no later than Jan 3, 2028.

sources.name: Jackson Lewis, Maryland employers' FAMLI contributions begin Jan 2027 (Jul 7, 2026)
Maryland Daily Record, Maryland prepares for paid family leave (Oct 14, 2026)
